review.notes: Full OCR read-through plus whole-document normalized word-level diff against extracted text of all 35 physical PDF pages; pages 4, 6, 8, 11, 12, 14, 16, 19 and 29 were additionally rendered and visually inspected. Table 4 numbers, empty DS-V3/Llama-3.1-405B cells and the running headers match the print. 'GQA with 8 kev-value heads' (physical p.4), 'AEGIS2. 0' (physical p.29) and the caption phrase 'turns that that refer to' reproduce typos printed by the PDF itself (verified at 400/260 dpi), so they were not patched. 'EPuB' (physical p.6) matches the PDF text layer. Text inside figure axes (e.g. 1e13 ticks) belongs to embedded figures. Remaining interleaving of the Table 4 block inside the evaluation list (table emitted after list item 1) is layout-level and was not restructured beyond restoring the split sentence.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.16 prints 'We use the mean and l2-norm aggregation functions along the batch and sequence dimensions' with a lowercase letter l before the 2 (visually verified); the PDF text layer also reads 'l2-norm'. OCR misread the letter l as the digit 1.
Rendered physical p.16 prints 'and l2-norm is sqrt(sum S_i^2)' with the same lowercase letter l (visually verified); OCR misread it as the digit 1.
